assertion.text: Erdős Problem #896: declared status 'solved'. Formalized: no. Estimate the maximum of $F(A,B)$ as $A,B$ range over all subsets of $\{1,\ldots,N\}$, where  $F(A,B)$ counts the number of $m$ such that $m=ab$ has exactly one solution (with $a\in A$ and $b\in B$). Prize: no. Tags: number theory.
